text: We need a piping engineer who has worked on food plants.
The package that worries me is the equipment base.
We want somebody whose drawings we can issue without a review.
This is the only office which has the headcount for it.
I want somebody whose drawings we can issue without a review.
The package that worries me most is the equipment base.
It would be a six-month secondment starting in April.
My question is who backfills the role while he is with us.

I read about twenty of these requests a week, and I can tell you in ten seconds which ones I can fill. The ones I can fill have a sentence after the job title. Not three paragraphs, one sentence. A piping engineer who has worked on food plants. A structural engineer whose foundation drawings we can issue without a review. That sentence is the whole search. Without it, I have forty names and no way to choose, so I write back and ask, and we lose a week. The other thing I need is the honest date. People give me a date that is two weeks earlier than the real one, because they think I will be late. Then I move somebody off another project to hit a date that did not exist, and now two teams are unhappy. Give me the sentence and the real date, and most requests close in two days.

I spent three months in Brazil on a secondment, and the work itself was the easy part. What nobody planned was my own desk in Helsinki. On paper somebody was going to cover my drawings, but that person already had a full workload, so for three months my old project ran with no piping lead. Nothing failed immediately. Things just got slower, and then a question about a pump base waited eleven days for an answer. When I came back, I had two projects to catch up with instead of one. So now, when a colleague tells me about a secondment, the first thing I ask is not where or how long. I ask who is backfilling, and whether that person has been told, because being told in the first week of the assignment is not the same as being asked in advance.

My question is who backfills the role while he is with us.
